cops.name: Workflow Orchestration
cops.behavioural_question: Is the task progressing coherently toward its intended state?

cops.name: Runtime Monitoring
cops.behavioural_question: Is the evidence required for this governance decision present, reliable and sufficiently complete?

cops.name: Anomaly Detection
cops.behavioural_question: Is the observed behaviour materially different from what is expected in this context?

cops.name: Context & Memory
cops.behavioural_question: Is the current context internally consistent, relevant to the task, and supported by useful precedent?

cops.name: Interaction Discovery
cops.behavioural_question: Who or what is interacting with whom, through what route, and how is the activity propagating?

cops.name: Incident Response
cops.behavioural_question: Do the current findings constitute an actionable incident, and what should happen now?

cops.name: Classification & Tagging
cops.behavioural_question: What kind of governance event is this, and which entities should remain associated with it?

cops.name: Policy Enforcement
cops.behavioural_question: Does the observed behaviour violate an explicit permission, policy, entitlement, boundary, or approval requirement?

cops.name: Risk Mitigation
cops.behavioural_question: Do the combined findings create a material or emerging risk, and what residual risk remains after available controls?

cops.name: Resource Management
cops.behavioural_question: Is resource consumption within entitlement and acceptable operating bounds?

cops.name: Governance Intelligence
cops.behavioural_question: What recurring patterns, concentrations or blind spots indicate a broader governance problem?

cops.name: Behavior Analytics
cops.behavioural_question: What behavioural pattern best characterizes this execution or sequence of executions?

cops.name: Recovery & Resilience
cops.behavioural_question: After failure or intervention, did the system return to a viable state without compounding the problem?

cops.name: Workload Optimization
cops.behavioural_question: Is the workload using tools, models, time and resources efficiently for the task being performed?

cops.name: Audit & Traceability
cops.behavioural_question: Can every consequential finding, decision and action be attributed and reconstructed from trustworthy evidence?

cops.name: Knowledge & Policy Management
cops.behavioural_question: Are the rules, policies and governance knowledge currently being used still current, coherent and internally consistent?

cops.name: Agent Lifecycle Management
cops.behavioural_question: Has an agent's identity, version, configuration, capability or connectivity changed in a way requiring governance attention?

cops.name: Governance Architecture
cops.behavioural_question: Does the current governance architecture adequately cover the estate and the behaviours actually occurring?

NONE.name: NONE
NONE.trigger: PASS, or FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE where no action is justified

WATCH.name: WATCH
WATCH.trigger: verified attention finding of low consequence
WATCH.on_failure: lapses with the session; nothing to undo
WATCH.verified_by: watch entry present in the decision record

REQUEST_CONTEXT.name: REQUEST_CONTEXT
REQUEST_CONTEXT.trigger: INCONCLUSIVE: a required artifact is missing and cannot be retrieved by any tool
REQUEST_CONTEXT.required_evidence: the missing item is named; no score minimum
REQUEST_CONTEXT.on_failure: on timeout the finding stays INCONCLUSIVE and the request is listed as open
REQUEST_CONTEXT.observable_result: a context request naming the missing artifact and who can supply it
REQUEST_CONTEXT.verified_by: the artifact appears in a later case (requirements.assess_requirements)

COLLECT_EVIDENCE.name: COLLECT_EVIDENCE
COLLECT_EVIDENCE.trigger: INCONCLUSIVE: a required item is MISSING_BUT_RETRIEVABLE with a permitted tool
COLLECT_EVIDENCE.required_evidence: the retrieving tool is in the COP's allowlist
COLLECT_EVIDENCE.on_failure: tool failure leaves the item missing; the next step becomes REQUEST_CONTEXT
COLLECT_EVIDENCE.observable_result: a bounded retrieval with the named tool

RECHECK.name: RECHECK
RECHECK.trigger: INCONCLUSIVE: a candidate was rejected for a recoverable reason (SC-01 value/citation, DS-03)
RECHECK.required_evidence: verifier feedback exists; no score minimum
RECHECK.on_failure: one bounded re-assessment; a second rejection delegates to the specialist
RECHECK.observable_result: a re-assessment verified by the same independent checks

SCHEDULE_REVIEW.name: SCHEDULE_REVIEW
SCHEDULE_REVIEW.trigger: verified aggregate or structural finding that needs a periodic, not immediate, review
SCHEDULE_REVIEW.on_failure: an unscheduled review is listed as overdue
SCHEDULE_REVIEW.observable_result: a review entry with a due date
SCHEDULE_REVIEW.verified_by: review entry present; outcome recorded by the reviewing COP

INSTRUCT.name: INSTRUCT
INSTRUCT.trigger: verified finding the agent can correct itself
INSTRUCT.on_failure: no confirmation: escalate to the operator
INSTRUCT.observable_result: an instruction delivered to the agent
INSTRUCT.verified_by: a later turn shows the instructed change

REQUEST_CORRECTION.name: REQUEST_CORRECTION
REQUEST_CORRECTION.trigger: verified drift or error the agent should correct
REQUEST_CORRECTION.on_failure: no correction observed: WATCH then ESCALATE
REQUEST_CORRECTION.observable_result: a correction request to the agent
REQUEST_CORRECTION.verified_by: the drifting metric returns to NORMAL in a later case

RETRY_WITH_CONSTRAINTS.name: RETRY_WITH_CONSTRAINTS
RETRY_WITH_CONSTRAINTS.on_failure: a second loop escalates to the specialist
RETRY_WITH_CONSTRAINTS.observable_result: a retry bounded by explicit limits
RETRY_WITH_CONSTRAINTS.verified_by: repetition metric below threshold after the retry

CHANGE_EXECUTION_PLAN.name: CHANGE_EXECUTION_PLAN
CHANGE_EXECUTION_PLAN.observable_result: a revised plan delivered to the agent
CHANGE_EXECUTION_PLAN.verified_by: milestones progress in a later case

ALERT.name: ALERT
ALERT.trigger: verified attention finding a human team should know of
ALERT.on_failure: delivery failure is recorded; the finding stands
ALERT.observable_result: an alert to the reviewing team
ALERT.verified_by: alert recorded with the finding id

REQUEST_COP_SUPPORT.name: REQUEST_COP_SUPPORT
REQUEST_COP_SUPPORT.trigger: bounded help from another COP: missing upstream finding, telemetry gap
REQUEST_COP_SUPPORT.required_evidence: the receiving COP owns the missing evidence
REQUEST_COP_SUPPORT.on_failure: hop limit or timeout returns the case to the initiator, then to a human
REQUEST_COP_SUPPORT.observable_result: a referral contract to the named COP
REQUEST_COP_SUPPORT.verified_by: the receiving COP publishes a verified finding

DELEGATE_TO_SPECIALIST.name: DELEGATE_TO_SPECIALIST
DELEGATE_TO_SPECIALIST.trigger: a decision the COP cannot resolve within its band: repeated failure, exhausted recovery, COP-specific specialist trigger
DELEGATE_TO_SPECIALIST.required_evidence: verifier results and the triage record travel with it
DELEGATE_TO_SPECIALIST.on_failure: cycle, hop limit, timeout or cost limit escalates to a human
DELEGATE_TO_SPECIALIST.observable_result: a specialist task with a referral contract
DELEGATE_TO_SPECIALIST.verified_by: the specialist's verified result returns to the initiator

ESCALATE.name: ESCALATE
ESCALATE.trigger: verified material finding needing a controlled workflow
ESCALATE.on_failure: unacknowledged escalation re-raises once, then stays open

OPEN_INCIDENT.name: OPEN_INCIDENT
OPEN_INCIDENT.on_failure: unacknowledged incident re-raises once, then stays open
OPEN_INCIDENT.observable_result: an incident record with the evidence chain

REQUEST_APPROVAL.name: REQUEST_APPROVAL
REQUEST_APPROVAL.trigger: verified APPROVAL_REQUIRED, or an operation pending a human decision
REQUEST_APPROVAL.required_evidence: verified finding, score >= 3, and a policy basis (PE-01)
REQUEST_APPROVAL.on_failure: no answer is a rejection (fail closed)

HOLD_TOOL_CALL.name: HOLD_TOOL_CALL
HOLD_TOOL_CALL.trigger: an operation is pending and the authoritative policy needed to judge it is missing
HOLD_TOOL_CALL.required_evidence: the pending operation and the missing policy are named; no score minimum
HOLD_TOOL_CALL.on_failure: a hold that cannot be applied leaves the operation un-evaluated and escalates
HOLD_TOOL_CALL.observable_result: the pending tool call is held
HOLD_TOOL_CALL.verified_by: EX-01 observes the hold; RELEASE_HOLD ends it

PAUSE_SESSION.name: PAUSE_SESSION
PAUSE_SESSION.trigger: verified incident or violation in a live session

BLOCK_OPERATION.name: BLOCK_OPERATION
BLOCK_OPERATION.trigger: verified VIOLATION of an explicit policy

RESTRICT_CAPABILITY.name: RESTRICT_CAPABILITY
RESTRICT_CAPABILITY.trigger: verified repeated violation by an agent

STOP_SESSION.name: STOP_SESSION
STOP_SESSION.trigger: verified critical incident with ongoing harm

REQUEST_ROLLBACK.name: REQUEST_ROLLBACK
REQUEST_ROLLBACK.on_failure: rollback not confirmed: VERIFY_RECOVERY fails, escalate
REQUEST_ROLLBACK.observable_result: a rollback request to the operator

RESTART_ISOLATED_SESSION.name: RESTART_ISOLATED_SESSION
RESTART_ISOLATED_SESSION.trigger: verified compromise needing a clean restart

VERIFY_RECOVERY.name: VERIFY_RECOVERY
VERIFY_RECOVERY.on_failure: unverifiable recovery escalates to a human

RELEASE_HOLD.name: RELEASE_HOLD
RELEASE_HOLD.trigger: a hold whose blocking condition has been resolved
RELEASE_HOLD.required_evidence: the resolving evidence (policy supplied, approval given)
RELEASE_HOLD.on_failure: release not confirmed leaves the hold in place

exercised_rule: a metric edge is exercised when a recorded decision of that COP read the metric with evidence OBSERVED or sufficiency RETRIEVED_AND_VALIDATED / PRESENT_BUT_UNVERIFIED; a COP edge is exercised when a recorded decision consulted the upstream finding or a referral was sent along it (a request_for_support event; a referral the router opened but no loop ran is shown on the decision, not counted here)
